problem:

$$
a(t)=⟨\frac{1}{2\sqrt{t}},\,3\sqrt{t}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Given that the particle has velocity $v=⟨-1,\,-14⟩$ when $t=1,$ calculate the time at which the particle is stationary. Do not round the answer.
